status: Proposed question protocol; not a validated questionnaire or production rules engine
defaults: No behavioral answer preselected. Country may be visibly suggested and edited. No unknown answer implies false.

questions.question: What would you like help with?
questions.vi: Bạn muốn được giúp điều gì?
questions.effect: Route the journey. Offer check, existing-device and browse routes bypass unrelated discovery questions.

questions.question: What are you choosing?
questions.vi: Bạn đang tìm thiết bị nào?
questions.effect: Choose question and catalog scope. Unknown routes to a clarification, not an arbitrary default.

questions.question: What is the maximum total you want to spend?
questions.vi: Bạn muốn chi tối đa bao nhiêu cho lần mua này?
questions.effect: User-confirmed hard ceiling in VND for the stated purchase scope. Values are illustrative preset ceilings, not market benchmarks. Unknown means no budget-personalized eligibility claim.

questions.question: What will you regularly use it for?
questions.vi: Bạn thường dùng laptop để làm gì?
questions.effect: Select all actual uses. Tasks route follow-ups; occupation does not set hardware minimums.

questions.question: What will you regularly use your phone for?
questions.vi: Bạn thường dùng điện thoại để làm gì?
questions.effect: Select all actual uses. Show relevant follow-ups; daily apps do not imply demanding workloads.

questions.question: What will you regularly use the PC for?
questions.vi: Bạn thường dùng PC để làm gì?
questions.effect: Select all actual uses. Route task-specific requirements and build scope.

questions.question: Which product conditions would you consider?
questions.vi: Bạn cân nhắc tình trạng máy nào?
questions.effect: Explicit new/used restriction. Unknown is not permission to recommend used as equivalent; disclose the assumption or ask before selecting a used offer.

questions.question: Which two tradeoffs matter most?
questions.vi: Hai ưu tiên nào quan trọng nhất với bạn?
options: Spend less while meeting my needs
questions.effect: Soft ranking priorities only. Choosing two must never discard any selected task or required feature.

questions.question: Which two tradeoffs matter most?
questions.vi: Hai ưu tiên nào quan trọng nhất với bạn?
options: Spend less while meeting my needs
questions.effect: Soft ranking only. Keep camera measurement, battery evidence and support facts distinct.

questions.question: Which two tradeoffs matter most?
questions.vi: Hai ưu tiên nào quan trọng nhất với bạn?
options: Spend less while meeting my needs
questions.effect: Soft ranking only; cannot override electrical, physical or workload compatibility.

questions.question: Is there anything the device must support?
questions.optionsSource: Category-relevant ports, peripherals, required apps, operating system, networking and accessibility needs; include no special requirement, other and unknown with correct exclusivity.
questions.effect: A marked must-have becomes a hard constraint. Brand or aesthetic preferences are not automatically hard requirements.

questions.trigger: Laptop/desktop coding, engineering, creative or local-AI use; phone required-work-app use.
questions.question: Which applications or tools do you need?
questions.optionsSource: Searchable maintained app list, Other with manual name, and Not sure. Ask version/architecture/backend only when relevant.
questions.effect: Retrieve vendor compatibility requirements and relevant workload evidence. Merely selecting an app does not confirm performance.

questions.trigger: User explicitly indicates virtual machines or emulators.
questions.question: How many virtual machines or emulators run at the same time?
questions.effect: Workload intensity signal; refine memory/CPU guidance with workload evidence rather than a universal RAM rule.

questions.question: Which games matter to you?
questions.optionsSource: Maintained searchable titles plus other and unknown.
questions.effect: Identify relevant game/anti-cheat/platform requirements; do not substitute a generic gamer label.

questions.trigger: Gaming selected and target materially changes the shortlist.
questions.question: What gaming experience are you aiming for?
questions.effect: Translate goals through relevant evidence. Custom numeric targets need a supported measurement basis.

questions.trigger: Creative use selected and project scale changes fit.
questions.question: What kind of projects do you usually work on?
questions.optionsSource: Task-specific choices, for example video resolution/codec or CAD model scope, with examples, other and unknown.
questions.effect: Avoid bundling unrelated project-size meanings into one generic heavy-work option.

questions.question: What do you mainly want to capture?
questions.effect: Weight relevant measured camera behaviors rather than megapixels.

questions.question: How often can you usually charge during your day?
options: Usually only at the end of the day
questions.effect: Context for battery priorities, not a promise of all-day measured runtime.

questions.question: Do you need to keep using a particular operating system?
questions.effect: A required platform is a hard constraint; lack of requirement does not establish app compatibility.

questions.trigger: User indicates accessibility/comfort needs or opens additional requirements.
questions.question: Which interaction needs should we account for?
questions.optionsSource: Readable larger text, hearing-related features, one-handed reach, input/peripheral needs, other, no additional needs, unknown.
questions.effect: Use non-diagnostic language and hands-on checks. Do not infer needs from age or require medical information.

questions.question: What must your PC budget include?
options: Only upgrades to an existing PC
questions.effect: Set explicit basket scope before a within-budget complete-build claim.

questions.question: Do you want to keep any existing parts or peripherals?
options: Yes, I will add the exact models
questions.effect: Check exact retained models and missing critical compatibility. Do not assume generic part names are enough.

questions.question: What device do you currently own?
questions.optionsSource: Model search, manual model entry and help finding the model.
questions.effect: Identify actual configuration and upgrade support; do not require a full new-device questionnaire.

questions.question: What are you hoping to improve?
questions.optionsSource: Task slowness, storage space, battery, physical fault, unsupported application, ergonomics, other, unknown.
questions.effect: Identify need for diagnosis or compatibility checks. A complaint alone is not proof of a hardware fault or bottleneck.

questions.question: When do you need the device?
options: I can wait for a suitable offer
questions.effect: Prioritize actual stock/deadlines or optional alerts. Date entry appears only when needed.

questions.question: Where should we check delivery or pickup?
questions.optionsSource: Broad city/delivery area, manual area and decide later. No GPS permission required.
questions.effect: Required before location-dependent delivery/stock totals can be verified; not necessary to browse general fit.

questions.question: Which payment options would you like to compare?
questions.effect: Keep total budget separate from payment schedule; do not infer loan eligibility or convert a monthly figure into a hidden larger purchase cap.

questions.question: Who will use the device?
questions.effect: Supports separate decision profiles and collaboration; no age, salary or identity is required.

rules: Route before profiling; browsing and checking an offer remain accessible without onboarding.
Ask about actual tasks before occupation; never derive requirements solely from job title.
Use radio-style controls for one answer and checkbox-style controls for multiple answers; label the selection rule.
Keep numeric budget presets ascending and stable. Include a custom exact ceiling and help setting a budget.
Unknown, skipped, not applicable and explicit no are different states.
Tasks and must-haves allow all relevant answers. Priority caps apply only to soft tradeoffs.
No-preference and unknown choices are exclusive with contradictory specific answers.
Do not preselect price, condition, OS, brand, financing or inferred behavioral preferences.
Critical unknowns block a confirmed-fit/fully-compatible claim, while allowing a clearly provisional preview.
Show a review summary with edit links, assumptions and unresolved requirements before finalizing the decision.
Changing category or intent invalidates derived answers and dependent task-specific branches; preserve only still-relevant answers.
Store a buying-decision profile rather than forcing one permanent person profile for all purchases.
Ask broad location before offer verification, and request optional account/notifications only at the point of benefit.
Initial core length and completion targets are hypotheses to test, not established UX laws.
